name: Steinkante
description:
The earth moves beneath a target's feet as sharp stones pierce through the ground underneath them. Choose a point you can see on the ground within range. Pillars of stone erupt in a wall, 5 feet wide and 30 feet tall, between you and the point. Creatures caught in the line must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a fail, or half as much on a save. They are additionally pushed to one side of the wall (you choose which side).

The wall has AC 10 and 30 Hit Points, and qualifies as Rock-type for resistances and vulnerabilities. Reducing the wall to 0 Hit Points destroys it.

When you execute this move, previous walls created by you using this move are destroyed.

updated.details: Move overhauled into a persistent wall.
